blends.name: Common Swapling Orchid Blend
blends.desc:
Blend 8 Common Orchid Petals for 1 Common Swapling Orchid. 

Earn Petals by mining on Alien Worlds Magor 16:3 

In order to have a chance to win OH NFTs for mining, you will need a AW License - Alpha Epoch
There are 2 ways to obtain this license. 
You can buy one for 444 KEIKI on NFThive (https://www.nfthive.io/drop/nfthivedrops/5548)
You can mint one in game on the Anvil page (80.00 PETAL, 40.00 FOOD, 20.00 FUEL)

You can play the Orchid Hunter game at orchidhunter.xyz
